ana: Quick check — prototype idea for a per-model "unit lens" in Console: token-level cost, cache-savings, and an effective unit cost that adjusts for QPS/batching. Also a "what-if" slider for batching/quantization. Anyone see a big gotcha?

shiv: Nice. Main open question: how do we attribute shared cache savings across multi-model chains? Proportional token usage last time miscredited prefetches.

leo: Prefetches are the annoying part. They inflate token counts without being on the hotpath. Maybe treat prefetch as tenant-level credit rather than attributing to the origin model.

mike: Practical concern: computing per-invocation token cost + delta from cache for every request added ~20ms in earlier run. If we add enrichment on-path for Console metrics it could affect SLOs.

infra-bot: FYI ingestion: metric_ingest_queue backlog at 0.6m events/day yesterday after the model-promo; pre-agg jobs will smooth this.

tara: Could we sample (1%) invocations, extrapolate totals, and surface CI bands in the UI? That should cut compute overhead and keep on-path light.

shiv: Sampling is fine but we need to show a confidence interval and be explicit about sampling rate. Ops will want a tolerable error bound. 95% CI bars please.

ana: (typo) -- sorry ana: Agree with sampling + CI. UX: show both "sampled estimate" and "billing-concordance" view. Also propose an "amortized unit cost" that breaks down: model compute, KV storage, network, cache-credits applied.

ana: example query to compute cache credit per model (pseudo-SQL):
```sql
-- daily pre-agg: tokens_by_model  (model_id, tenant_id, total_tokens, cache_hits)
SELECT m.model_id, m.tenant_id, SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens, 
       SUM(cache_hits) AS hits, 
       COALESCE(SUM(cache_hits) * avg_token_cost, 0) AS cache_credit
FROM tokens_by_model m
WHERE day = '{{day}}'
GROUP BY model_id, tenant_id;
```

mike: That pre-agg + join approach is better. Avoids per-invocation joins. But watch join cardinality if tenant/model matrix is large — pre-agg granularity matters.

leo: UX tweak: toggle between "show billed cost" (what customers see) and "resource cost" (what infra spent) — useful for sales vs infra conversations.

tara: Rollout suggestion: canary to 5% of tenants, run for 7 days, compare Console unit-lens totals vs billing ledger nightly. Abort if drift > 2% or if sampling CI > 5% relative error.

ana: Checklist I'm adding to the ticket: 1) sampling flag + CI in UI, 2) daily pre-agg topology, 3) enrichment-safe API path for console, 4) canary book + abort rules, 5) doc blurb for customers. :eyes: :+1:

shiv: I'll own the pre-agg job (ETA: 2 weeks). Will include a sampled stream for validation.

mike: I'll profile on-path enrichment overhead and propose an async fallback. Preliminary: enrichment + prefetch lookup ~8ms p50, 22ms p95. With 1% sampling we should be within SLO headroom. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll put a small mock of the toggle + CI bars in Figma and link it to the ticket.

tara: I'll run the canary playbook once we have pre-agg metrics and UI flag.

ana: Awesome — creating tickets: DATA-456 (pre-agg + sampled stream), CONSOLE-789 (UI + CI toggle), OPS-101 (canary runbook). Will drop links here once created. Thanks all!
